svg.title: Europe city network
svg.desc: Orthographic globe from public-domain Natural Earth geographic data. Cities: LONDON, PARIS, ZURICH, MILAN, MONACO. City markers are at their geographic coordinates; labels use leader lines.
svg.metadata: Made with Natural Earth. Land geometry: world-atlas 2.0.2 land-50m.json, derived from Natural Earth 4.1.0. Projection: D3 geoOrthographic. Coordinates: longitude, latitude in WGS84 degrees.
